summary: Sagtec Global Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing a confidential settlement agreement with Helena Global Investment Opportunities I Ltd. to resolve a lawsuit over a July 2025 purchase agreement. Terms include a $250,000 payment ($100,000 paid, $150,000 due within 90 days) and voluntary dismissal without prejudice. No admission of liability. Sagtec expects no material adverse financial effect. Watch for timely final payment.
